name: Kit Issue
description: One optional flavor check, same shape as The Road In's a-flourish: never costs anything on any result, exists to make a moment vivid rather than to test anyone.

dc.basis: level 1 DC 15, one step easy — this is a treat, not a test

outcomes.criticalSuccess: It sits right immediately -- a good line, a clean draw, whatever the character's own equipment was. Nobu, mid-sentence to someone else, notices anyway and says so without stopping what he's doing.
outcomes.failure: A small, funny fumble -- a strap on backwards, a stance that isn't quite it yet. Nothing that matters, and nobody here has time to make it a moment.
outcomes.criticalFailure: Comically clumsy, entirely harmless -- and completely ignored, because Nobu is already three sentences into something else.

notes: Offer once per player at most, and only if someone wants a moment with their own new gear. If nobody bites, the scene loses nothing -- same design rule as a-flourish (c1s1-the-road-in.json).
